title: RexbrX's Umbrella Mod
body:
This mod Adds a single Umbrella to your World, you can use them in combat or to avoid obstacles.

![Umbrella Render](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4cc953083026ea3f9e551f55e794511c8e4666d8.png)

You can use the umbrellas to avoid obstacles or to cause damage on them, it's a versatile combat item.
